en: Vintage Christmas-themed illustration showing a 19th‑century Central European family in their parlor around a decorated Christmas tree with candles and ornaments. A man in uniform, likely a postman or soldier, is delivering letters or cards to the father, mother, and children. At the bottom, ornate decorative text in a Czech style script reads "Poštovní knížka" with the year "1900" on the right. Additional small print at the bottom credits the publisher A. Neubert in Jilemnice, in Bohemia.
